parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The criterion by which you want to sort the queried instances. Valid values:

*   **ExpireTime**
*   **CreateTime**

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The order by which you want to sort the queried instances. Valid values:

*   **asc**
*   **desc**

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the cache reserve instance. Valid values:

*   **online**: The instance is in service.
*   **offline**: The instance has expired within an allowable period. In this state, it is unavailable.
*   **disable**: The instance has been released.
*   **overdue**: The instance has been stopped due to overdue payments.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa list-cache-reserve-instances --status online --sort-by ExpireTime --sort-order desc --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --instance-id sp-xcdn-96wblslz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa ListCacheReserveInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Status online --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --InstanceId 'sp-xcdn-96wblslz0000' --SortBy ExpireTime --SortOrder desc
